verdict.rationale: YYLO is a local CLI orchestrator installed via npm and initialized inside a checkout. The evidence documents no one-click install, such as a GitHub App or OAuth grant, that gives an agent access to a user's repositories. The GitHub-issues integration and skills installation are adjacent features, not a repository-access grant flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup
